name: Enumerated Tuplet Contract Freeze

semanticRules: The single-cell triplet sign is generally used for a triplet of any value.
Irregular groups other than three use the multi-cell grouping form.

nonGoals: Do not invent a generic numeric grouping encoder.
Do not change existing 3:2 MusicXML triplet behavior.
Do not change H4C or H4D polyphony behavior.
